items.action: Move the existing Salesforce DX implementation into a salesforce/ package without losing tracked content or deploy configuration.

evidence.proves: A scripted SHA-256 comparison found all 33 original tracked files present and byte-for-byte unchanged after relocation, excluding the intentionally edited README.
The relocated package resolves its LWC source paths and passes ESLint after correcting the inherited unmatched Aura glob and two inherited lint findings.

items.action: Add a standalone browser JavaScript XOR neural-network implementation that preserves the useful algorithm and behavioral tests from morrismarkw/nn.

evidence.proves: Four dependency-free Node tests cover validation, a known forward pass, detached model shape, and deterministic XOR convergence.

items.action: Document the two implementations at the monorepo root and verify both implementation packages locally.

evidence.proves: The root README identifies and links both independent implementations and gives local test and run commands.
Visual inspection confirmed the responsive interface renders; an interactive run converged after 1,300 epochs with correct XOR predictions.
The root test command executes the standalone implementation suite successfully.
